answer: Require every agent to stake a deposit that vests slowly, like a knoll rising from a flat field: cheap to join, expensive to multiply. New identities start with whisper-quiet reputation and earn trust only through verified work over time, so a Sybil farm must pay the full waiting cost for each clone. When one identity misbehaves, the penalty ripples to its stake and to the identities that vouched for it, making mass fakery unprofitable while honest newcomers can still climb.
